shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at x=10 where the arch reaches the horizontal axis on the left with the upper-right mark on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at x=10. Right image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(7)=150.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=10. On the right, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate.
